newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down on profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks lost more than one percent as investors booked profit on shares which gained in recent sessions, brokers said.
The benchmark price index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) shed 28.53 points or 1.06 percent at 2,661.61 on a turnover of 100.9 million taka. Of 98 traded issues, 54 lost and 44 gained.
"Small investors are not taking any risk. They are not holding back shares for longer period," said one broker.
Monno Fabrics lost 14.08 taka to 267.46, Bata Shoe shed 14.39 to 273.36 and Square Pharma gained 86.94 to 1,825.75.
